messages.content: Review this fully synthetic demo contract clause and return one concise business risk about prepaid fees. Use short clause-specific values. Use jurisdiction "not specified". Do not use placeholder values. For supporting_text, copy this exact phrase from the clause: "may retain all prepaid fees after suspension". Clause: Vendor may suspend the service for any operational reason with immediate effect, may retain all prepaid fees after suspension, and Customer must indemnify Vendor for third-party claims arising from Customer data even when Vendor's own security controls contributed to the claim. This fixture uses fictional generic parties only and is not based on a real customer contract.
